### From Differential Geometry to General Relativity

Graduate course at IFUSP, University of São Paulo (3 credits; 18 h of lectures + 9 h of practical sessions), built on my open lecture notes and accompanying Python material.

::: {.media-actions}
[Lecture notes](assets/files/docs/from_differential_geometry_to_general_relativity.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-info .btn-sm}
[GitHub](https://github.com/daniellopezcano/differential_geometry){.btn .btn-outline-info .btn-sm}
:::
:::
:::

::: {.project-card .activity-card}
::: {.project-card-body}
::: {.media-meta}
Instructor · 1st IFUSP Winter School · July 2026
:::

### Neural Networks: Applications in Physics

Four-day minicourse (taught in Portuguese) at the I Escola de Inverno do IFUSP. It goes from JAX fundamentals through domain shift and contrastive learning to two cosmology case studies, and each day pairs a theory block with a hands-on JAX notebook runnable in Colab.

::: {.media-actions}
[School page](https://portal.if.usp.br/pesquisa/pt-br/node/2745){.btn .btn-outline-info .btn-sm}
[GitHub](https://github.com/daniellopezcano/I-Escola-de-Inverno-do-IFUSP){.btn .btn-outline-info .btn-sm}
:::
:::
:::
